newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai rice futures fail to trade for second day.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai rice futures fail to trade for second day.

text.p: Shanghai rice futures did not trade on Thursday with the active stock markets continuing to attract investors interest, traders said.
Traders said many investors had moved their money into the stock market due to a lack of interest in the rice market.
"The stock markets in Shanghai and Shenzhen have risen sharply in the past few days, attracting much of the money from retail investors," one trader said.
Traders expect rice trading to remain slow in the next few days.
